label: WaterMelonControl
description: WaterMelonControl adds Karoo data page widgets for sideloaded media apps, including now playing, playback controls, tap-to-open, and device music volume control.
releaseNotes:
### 1.3.7 Stability

- Improves listener lifecycle cleanup and permission-revocation safety.
- Reduces unnecessary PLAYING widget redraws.
- Fixes Karoo 2 notification-access guidance.
- Adds production signing and certificate verification safeguards.
- Keeps releases local/manual; GitHub Actions release workflow removed.
